question.text: A scientist proposes a new temperature scale in which the ice point is $25 \mathrm{X}(\mathrm{X}$ is the new unit of temperature) and the steam point is $305 \mathrm{X}$. The specific heat capacity of water in this new scale is $\left(\operatorname{in} J \mathrm{kg}^{-1} \mathrm{X}^{-1}\right)$
